description.p: PixelFx is a quick photo editor for the Linux desktop. Make a photo better while you watch it: one-click looks shown on your own photo, presets, every light and colour control you expect, and batch editing of many photos at once.

ul.li: Looks: Vivid, Warm, Film, Golden hour, Teal and orange, Noir and more, each tile showing your own photo, with a strength slider. Bring your own .cube LUTs, or make your own look from steps.
Light, colour, curves, colour mixer, colour grading, detail, effects and optics, with a histogram and clipping warnings.
Presets: save the whole edit or only parts of it, apply them with one click, and bring your Lightroom and Camera Raw presets (.xmp).
Crop and rotate, straighten with a dial or a drawn line, fix leaning buildings, and square a page or a wall from its four corners.
Heal blemishes, dust and small objects with a spot or a brush.
Camera RAW, HEIC, AVIF and JPEG XL photos, with lens corrections from the Lensfun database.
Batch: process whole folders with a preset, a size, a watermark and a format, in the background.
Export to JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP and more, with sizes for the web and for print, and an optional watermark.
Your edits are kept for every photo, and the original file is never changed.

description.p: PixelFx 2 is rebuilt from scratch: a new editor, a new image engine and a new look.
